text:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout for release v2.3.4 -> 10% traffic. Plan: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 10m pauses. Change window 2025-03-24 03:00-04:00 UTC. Reply here with "stop" or "go". Deploy ID: deploy-9876

sahil: seeing uptick in 95p latency on api/generate at 03:12 UTC. Spike aligns with first batch.

maria: confirmed. Errors (5xx) from infer-service on q4 hosts +10/min.

carla: hold at 10% for now. Can we get logs and recent kernel flags?

sahil: attaching minimal logs below:
```
[2025-03-24T03:12:21Z] ERROR infer-service: kernel_select failed for model redwood-v1.int8 request_id=req_42f
stack: RuntimeError: no compatible kernel for matmul_fast_quant
```

deploy-bot: Noted. Pausing automated promotion. Rollout now held at 10%. (deploy-9876 paused)

qa-jen: I can reproduce locally with quantized build - appears to be a fallback path that increases memory and triggers timeouts.

maria: looks like q4 nodes pulled quantized artifact missing AVX512 kernel. We need a quick pin to non-quantized variant for safety.

eng-lead-tom: decision call: stop promotion, rollback traffic to v2.3.3 (previous stable). We'll pin routing and open a canary-only debug build for v2.3.4 on dedicated debug pool. Any objections?

sahil: +1 for rollback. We should also capture KV-cache warmup traces.

pm-nate: logging this as change-impact for release notes and incident followup.

deploy-bot: executing rollback -> pin traffic to v2.3.3. Command: /rollout pin --service=infer-service --to-version=v2.3.3 --reason="kernel mismatch on quantized nodes"

deploy-bot: Rollback started at 03:16 UTC. Progress: migrating 100% of weighted traffic back to v2.3.3.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 03:18 UTC. System health: api/generate 95p latency back to baseline, errors down.

carla: creating issue: infra#2047 "quant kernel guard + fallback telemetry". I'll add steps and assign to eng-runtime.

sahil: added example request_id=req_42f and attached profiler traces to infra#2047.

pm-nate: Can we add a one-liner to release notes: "Rolled back v2.3.4 due to quantization kernel mismatch; v2.3.4 will be revalidated in debug canary."

eng-lead-tom: I'll schedule a short postmortem and followups: (1) kernel availability checks in compile phase (2) richer canary telemetry (3) rollback runbook updates.

carla: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Closing thread. Tagging owners: eng-runtime, infra, qa.
